rationale: Playbook PG-EXF-002 matched on alert ALRT-0005. The principal eve.contractor@eproc.test operating as database role analyst_ro read 1 statements against public.contracts between 2026-08-07T23:05:00Z and 2026-08-07T23:17:00Z. The standing playbook for bulk sensitive reads revokes the read grant that was used, terminates the live backend, and preserves the statement sample for the investigator.
rollback:
GRANT SELECT ON public.contracts TO analyst_ro;
DELETE FROM incident_hold WHERE alert_id = 'ALRT-0005';

alert_summary.rule_name: Bulk export via COPY TO STDOUT

evidence.statement: SELECT payment_id, invoice_no, amount, bank_account_snapshot FROM payments
SELECT p.payment_id, p.bank_account_snapshot, v.legal_name, v.bank_account FROM payments p JOIN contracts c USING (contract_id) JOIN vendors v USING (vendor_id)
COPY (SELECT payment_id, invoice_no, amount, bank_account_snapshot FROM payments) TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER

baseline_context.note: Role analyst_ro normally returns about 3947 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
